title: Language Model Integration
summary: This module provides the core infrastructure for interacting with various language models, including client implementations, API communication, caching, and utility functions.

nodes.label: Base LM Clients
nodes.title: Base Language Model Clients
nodes.description: Defines the foundational `BaseLM` class and concrete implementations for local and cloud-based (Databricks, OpenAI) LM providers, supporting finetuning and deployment.

nodes.label: LM API Interaction
nodes.title: LM API Interaction
nodes.description: Provides synchronous and asynchronous functions for interacting with Language Model APIs, primarily via LiteLLM, handling request formatting, caching, and retry logic.

nodes.label: Caching and Utilities
nodes.title: Caching and Utilities
nodes.description: Offers caching mechanisms for language model interactions and utility functions for managing cache behavior and LiteLLM logging.

nodes.label: Program Execution & Primitives
nodes.title: Program Execution & Primitives
nodes.description: The core DSPy modules and primitives that define how programs are structured and executed, relying on LMs for their operations.

groups.label: Language Model Providers
groups.title: Language Model Providers
groups.description: Manages the connection and interaction with various language models, both local and cloud-based.

groups.label: API Communication Layer
groups.title: API Communication Layer
groups.description: Handles the technical details of sending requests to and receiving responses from language model APIs.

groups.label: Support Services
groups.title: Support Services
groups.description: Provides essential services like caching to optimize performance and logging for debugging and monitoring.
